scripts.setup: bun install --cwd web-desktop && bun install --cwd mobile
scripts.sync:mobile: cd mobile && bun scripts/sync-frontend-lib.ts && bun scripts/sync-rust-modules.ts
scripts.check:quick: bun scripts/schema-audit.ts && bun scripts/audit-sync-contract.ts && bun scripts/audit-docs.ts && cd web-desktop && bun run check:quick && cd ../mobile && bun run check:quick
